stem:
The Cabinet Mission was sent to India for which of the following?
1. To establish a national government
2. To work out a constitutional arrangement for the transfer of power
3. To work out the details of Jinnah's demand for Pakistan

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The Cabinet Mission (1946), chaired by the Secretary of State for India, Lord Pethick-Lawrence, with two other members— Stafford Cripps and A.V. Alexander—was sent to prepare a constitutional arrangement for the transfer of power in India.

stem: Cabinet Mission was presided over by :
expl: The Cabinet Mission (1946), chaired by the Secretary of State for India, Lord Pethick-Lawrence, with two other members— Stafford Cripps and A.V. Alexander—was sent to prepare a constitutional arrangement for the transfer of power in India.

stem: The Cabinet Mission came to India in :

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above.

expl: The Cabinet Mission arrived at Karachi (then in India) on 23 March, 1946. It reached Delhi on 24 March, 1946. Its chairman was Lord Pethick-Lawrence (Secretary of State for India), and the other two members were Stafford Cripps (President of the Board of Trade) and A.V. Alexander (First Lord of the Admiralty).
